title: Songs of the Sunscar
changes: Act 2 has its own music: "Song of the Second Sun" greets you the first time you step through the waygate
Calm tunes for Kel Ashar, the dunes, the oases and the Buried City, "Sand and Steel" for desert fights, and "Ishael, the Sunwright" for the final battle at the Sun Furnace
All seven songs can also be picked in the Music menu
